name: Full Moon
design_intent:
ORBIT circuit, slot 2 (diff 2). Lesson: SUSTAINED RADIAL NAVIGATION -- turn moonwalk's single arc into a full orbit habit. Builds directly on g6_moonwalk (planet-is-floor): one moon (body_r 200, field r 1000, g 1300, visual moon) centered at (960,200); six COLLECT_ALL tokens ring it evenly at radius 340 from center (~140px off the 200px surface), so you must ride the curved floor ALL THE WAY AROUND the planetoid to sweep them up. Objective = COLLECT_ALL (all six group 'trials_pickup' latched 'collected'); the tokens ARE the goal (t_token_dash pattern -- no goal_gate).

FLIGHT-REQUIRED / movement-tool-per-gap: tokens sit at 60-degree spacing (arc chord between adjacent tokens ~340px along a radius-340 ring, but the FAR-SIDE tokens are >1500px of straight-line distance across the moon). No single bounce can reach the far hemisphere: a trampoline apex off the surface is 270px and stays deep inside the r1000 field (200+270 << 1000), so a passive bounce always re-attaches to the SAME face -- to bring a far token into reach you must FLY around the limb (feather boost tangentially, let radial gravity hold you to the floor). Each surface touch refunds +20 fuel, so a full loop is fuel-positive; the only way to lose is to boost radially OUT past r1000 into global-down space and fall out the bottom bound = free respawn at the north-pole start_gate. Bounds frame the whole r1000 field with ~640px side margin.
hint: ORBIT THE WHOLE MOON — SWEEP EVERY TOKEN
